D) Persons acted as witness in Agreement such, as Shamsul Haq Ripon Sheikh and Scribe Abul Bashar had not been produced and examined by Vendor in proof of Agreement 

 8. Burden of- proof is- the obligation to adduce evidence to the satisfaction of Court in order to establish the existence or non existence of a fact contended by a party. The provision as to burden of proof IS founded on the rule" ei incumbit probatio quit dicet non que negat" the burden of proving a fact rests upon the party who substantially asserts the affirmative of the issue and not upon the party who denies it; for a negative is usually incapable of proof. This Rule is derived from Roman Law and, is supportable not only on the ground of fairness but, also, upon that of the greater practical difficulty is involved in proving a negative than in proving an affirmative. 

 9. Vendor-Petitioner asserted that the sale deed was accompanied by an Agreement of re-conveyance with the condition of re-conveyance within a period of five (5) years. Admittedly, the sale deed is registered one but the Agreement is unregistered. Agreement was scribed by Abdul Bashar and attested by witnesses Shamsul Nuq Munshi and Ripon Sheikh. In proof of Agreement neither the scribe nor the attesting witnesses had been examined from P' side of Vendor-petitioner. Vendor-petitioner signally failed to discharge the burden of proof which was upon him in respect of legal existence of Agreement. Learned Appellate Judge duly took into account this apposite legal aspect of the case.
